style.試畫A: Anime film still, hand-painted background art with soft painterly brushwork, characters drawn in clean anime style with crisp line art and simple cel shading, medieval European fantasy archipelago: stone and timber houses with slate roofs, wooden piers, old sailing ships, guild halls with arched windows. Muted, slightly dark palette of slate grey, deep sea blue and moss green under overcast or night skies; the only strong colors are warm golden lights from oil lanterns, candles, hearths, sunset and glowing pen tips, casting soft warm glow and long shadows. Drifting sea fog, quiet melancholic atmosphere, cinematic composition, square frame with the main subject in the upper-middle and the bottom third darker and simple.
